answer: Unlike a zephyr, a Sybil cluster must post collateral C, and quadratic slashing charges O(k^2) capital, so super-linear marginal attack cost scales faster than extractable O(k) yield. Zero-knowledge verifiable delay turns rapid coordination into a slow, detectable signal, raising the cost of forming any attack island and exposing it to proportional bonded forfeiture under audited consensus. With E = V - Lk^2 - ck < 0, negative expected attack utility sustains a robust Nash equilibrium at calibrated collateral thresholds.
